changes.comment: refactor!: redesign localization around explicit locale catalogs. Replaces createI18n()/hydrateI18n() with createTranslationStore()/hydrateTranslationStore(), resources with catalogs, and I18n state version 2 with TranslationState version 3. Removes namespace/resource APIs and LinguaMissingResourceError. Use createTranslator() for fixed-locale translation.
